title: Password reset
text: If a password reset email has not arrived, check the address entered on the reset form and look in the spam folder. Request a fresh reset link after confirming the address. Avoid sharing passwords or reset links in a support conversation.

title: Sign-in troubleshooting
text: When sign-in fails, record the exact error message and check whether the issue occurs in a private browser window. This helps distinguish a saved browser session from an account problem. Share the error wording with support without including a password.

title: Unexpected charge
text: To investigate an unfamiliar charge, compare the date and amount with the billing history available in the account. Check whether another workspace or subscription could explain the difference. Contact support with the transaction date and amount, excluding complete payment details.

title: Invoice details
text: If an invoice appears to contain incorrect billing information, review the information saved in the account before contacting support. State which field needs correction and which invoice is affected. Support can explain the available process after reviewing the request.

title: Missing updates
text: When recent changes are missing on another device, first confirm that both devices are signed in to the same account. Check the connection and refresh the application. Note which change is missing and when it was made so support can investigate.

title: Upload interruption
text: If an upload stops before completion, keep the original file and note any error message. Check the connection and confirm that the file meets the application's stated requirements. Retry once when appropriate, then provide support with the error wording and file type.
